identity.name: Web App Testing
identity.description: Drives a real browser (Playwright) to test web applications: navigation, form filling, assertion of visible state, screenshot capture, network-request inspection. Useful for smoke-testing a deployed app or as a CI verification step.

capability.summary: Execute browser-based tests against a web app

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Entry URL to the application under test.

inputs.name: scenario
inputs.description: Ordered list of steps (navigate, click, type, assert).

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Pass/fail per step, screenshots, console logs, network requests.

scoring.rationale: Browses real systems; can submit forms or trigger emails if scenario includes write actions. Risk depends on the scenario.
